name: pr_submit_review
description: Post one formal GitHub review. APPROVE posts the selected findings and approves; REQUEST_CHANGES posts revision feedback without approval. Input: repo, number, structured, event?.

repo.description: Repo slug or URL owning the PR. Falls back to repoUrl when omitted.

repoUrl.description: Repo URL owning the PR, used when repo is not supplied.

structured.description: The agent's structured findings: {summary?, verdict?, comments?}. Accepts a dict or a JSON string, parsed before use.

event.description: Explicit gh review event override (APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES/COMMENT). When omitted, derived from structured.verdict: 'request_changes' -> REQUEST_CHANGES, else APPROVE.

reviewed.description: Always true once a review has been posted (with or without inline comments).

event.description: The gh review event that was actually posted.

inlineCount.description: Number of inline comments posted with the review; 0 if inline anchoring failed and findings were folded into the summary instead.

inline.description: True if inline comments were accepted by GitHub; false if the review had to be retried summary-only after a 422.

url.description: HTML URL of the posted review.
